name: Password Spray and Impossible-Travel Sign-In
description: Password spray is trying a few common passwords against many accounts so lockouts stay low. Impossible travel is a login from two far-apart places faster than a plane can fly. Anonymous VPNs, known-bad IPs, and a new country on an admin account are the same family of 'this is not the employee at their desk.' One lockout is a typo. A surge of failures plus a success from a VPN is a break-in. Correlate lockouts, sprays, and travel; do not treat them as separate curiosities.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
